symbols.name: round count
symbols.meaning: The number of rounds of the transform, a=log_2 t.
symbols.quote: put $a=\log_2t$, the number of rounds (here $a$ changes meaning)

symbols.name: output index
symbols.meaning: The position of an output of the transform.
symbols.quote: with input positions $k$ and output index $j$ (here $j$ changes meaning: it is the position of an output of the transform)

symbols.name: completed rounds
symbols.meaning: The number of rounds completed so far.
symbols.quote: After $s$ rounds, $s$ being the number of completed rounds, slots $a-1,\dots,a-s$ hold frequency bits $0,\dots,s-1$ and the rest index a sequence of length $t/2^s$; the next round writes bit $s$ into slot $a-1-s$.

symbols.name: bit-reversal permutation
symbols.meaning: The permutation moving the entry at j to rev_a(j).
symbols.quote: Let $B_t$ be the permutation moving the entry at $j$ to $\operatorname{rev}_a(j)$

symbols.name: parallel butterfly
symbols.meaning: The parallel butterfly applying H_0 on every participating axis in one round.
symbols.quote: With several axes, indexed by $i$, a round applies $H_0$ on every participating axis, and $\mathcal H$ denotes this one parallel butterfly.

symbols.name: recordwise monomial
symbols.meaning: The recordwise operation multiplying each record by y^E.
symbols.quote: Twiddles group into one monomial $J_E$, the recordwise operation multiplying the record by $y^E$, where $E$ depends on the address, not coefficients:

relations.quote: It orders the outputs of the [synthetic polynomial transform](synthetic-transform.md) over $\mathcal R_r=\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$, normed by the largest coefficient modulus.

derivations.quote: Multiplying by a power of $y$ permutes coefficients and flips signs, so every power of $\omega_t$ is an isometry. Each entry averages $t$ such images, so both transforms contract.
Replacing $k$ by $k+t/2^{v+1}$ modulo $t$ permutes the summands and multiplies the sum by $y^{rj_0}=-1$, so the sum equals its negative.
The additive group of $\mathcal R_r$ has no two-torsion (no nonzero element equals its negative), so the sum is zero
Apply $H_0$ to each pair, multiply the $b=1$ output by $\omega_t^{-k}$, and recurse on the two length-$t/2$ branches.
After $a$ rounds $(F_t^-z)_j$ sits at slot $\operatorname{rev}_a(j)$, where $\operatorname{rev}_a$ reverses the $a$ binary digits of $j$.
Each forward level is invertible, and as $H_0^2=I/2$ the reversed level is half its inverse, so the reverse procedure composed with $B_tF_t^-$ is $2^{-a}I=I/t$.
By character cancellation $F_t^+B_t^{-1}$ composed with $B_tF_t^-$ is also $I/t$. As $B_tF_t^-$ is invertible (a product of invertible levels) the two reverse operators agree.
With several axes, indexed by $i$, a round applies $H_0$ on every participating axis, and $\mathcal H$ denotes this one parallel butterfly.
Twiddles group into one monomial $J_E$, the recordwise operation multiplying the record by $y^E$, where $E$ depends on the address, not coefficients:
$\mathcal H$ is a contraction and $J_E$ an isometry, so every round is a contraction.
